current_date: No adoption date stated in the page text; page shows 'Last Modified October 17, 2025' (content matches the revised list consulted on in 2023, which replaced the list adopted 10 May 2021)
current_evidence: The council's own 'Local validation checklist' page (last modified 17 Oct 2025) states the local requirements applications must meet; a separate 'Existing local validation checklist' page holds the 10 May 2021 list and the 2023 consultation statement describes the revised list, so Grokbot's .doc in the democracy 'members/admin/files' store (citing GDPO 1995, EIA Regs SI 1999/293 and old A3 use classes) is a superseded pre-2021 checklist.

issues.detail: The 'Validation list URL' is an old Word checklist stored in the democracy committee file store, not the current list. It references the GDPO 1995, the EIA Regulations SI 1999/293 and Use Class A3. WebFetch returned only binary data for it. The current list is the Local-validation-checklist.aspx web page. Grokbot did also read that page, but recorded the old .doc as the reference link.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger text from the .doc: 'Article 7 of the Town and Country Planning (General Development Procedure) Order 1995'; 'The Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations (SI 1999/293)'

issues.detail: List date is blank and flagged 'Undated'. The council pages are dated: the current Local validation checklist page shows 'Last Modified October 17, 2025', and the previous list was 'formally adopted 10 May 2021' after consultation from 9 April to 7 May 2021.
issues.evidence: Local validation checklist page: 'Last Modified October 17, 2025'; Existing local validation checklist page: adopted 10 May 2021

issues.detail: Most of the requirements are taken from the superseded .doc, mixed with a few from the current page. These include Air Quality Assessment (AQMA), Flood Risk Assessment (national 1 ha / Flood Zone 2-3 wording), Archaeological Assessment, Lighting Assessment, Structural Survey, Transport Assessment ('thresholds set out in Table 4 (Appendix A)'), S106 Heads of Terms and odour/extraction for 'Use Classes A3'. None of these appears in the current Blackpool local list, so the sheet does not reflect current requirements.
issues.evidence: Current page headings run from Conservation areas to Certificates of lawfulness for existing residential uses; there is no air quality, archaeology, lighting or structural survey requirement

issues.detail: Sites within 6 km of Blackpool Airport: all applications other than change of use must state the maximum height of the development above ordnance datum. This was not captured.
issues.evidence: 'Sites within 6 km of Blackpool Airport' - applications other than change of use must specify maximum height above ordnance datum

issues.detail: Major-scale proposals other than change of use need a SUDS proforma and concept drainage strategy, plus a biodiversity matrix for the existing and proposed site. Grokbot's Drainage row instead quotes old trade-waste and non-mains foul text, and neither the SUDS proforma nor the biodiversity matrix appears.
issues.evidence: Major scale proposals (residential) and (non-residential): 'SUDS proforma and concept drainage strategy; biodiversity matrix'

issues.detail: These sustainability and infrastructure items were not captured: renewable energy statement (major and minor residential), BREEAM design-stage interim certificate showing 'very good' (major non-residential), and full-fibre broadband statement (major and minor non-residential). Grokbot's Energy/Sustainability row gives only the minor non-residential sustainability statement, run together with the 5-storey TVIA text.
issues.evidence: Major non-residential: 'BREEAM design-stage interim certificate ... very good'; 'full-fibre broadband statement'; Minor residential: 'Renewable energy statement'

issues.detail: These area-based requirements were not captured: (1) Flood zones 2 and 3: a sequential appraisal and, where necessary, the exceptions test for new-build; (2) Ecologically sensitive locations: an ecological appraisal, or an ecologist's confirmation, where the site includes or is within 500 m of a pond, Biological Heritage Site, SSSI or habitats site, or is a greenfield site with trees, hedgerows or shrubs; (3) Blackpool Victoria Hospital and Blackpool and Fylde College: a site parking review for any material increase in floorspace or loss of parking. Grokbot's Flood and Ecology rows carry generic old text instead.
issues.evidence: Current page 'By area' sections: Flood zones 2 and 3; Ecologically sensitive locations; Blackpool Victoria Hospital and Blackpool and Fylde College

issues.detail: These use-specific requirements were not captured: (1) Holiday accommodation areas: a viability study for change of use away from holiday accommodation; (2) Employment areas: at least 12 months of marketing evidence for loss of employment use; (3) Leisure impact assessment for major non-sports leisure outside the resort core and town centre; (4) Management plan for residential care, supported housing and student accommodation; (5) Bat survey or ecologist statement for proposals involving demolition; (6) Tree survey in conservation areas where root protection areas are affected or trees removed.
issues.evidence: Current page sections: Holiday accommodation areas; Employment areas; Leisure uses outside the defined resort core and town centre; Residential care uses, supported housing and student accommodation; Proposals involving demolition

issues.detail: Transport Assessment/Statement and Travel Plan are placed under 'Change of use - prior approval'. The source applies them to major-scale proposals 'other than change of use', which is the opposite of that placement. Ventilation/Extraction (odour) is also placed under prior approval, but it comes from old A3 change-of-use text that relates to full applications.
issues.evidence: 'Major scale proposals (residential) - other than change of use ... A transport statement or transport assessment and travel plan as required by appendix G2'

issues.detail: The only Householder row is named 'Schedule of works (listed building)', but its excerpt is the demolition method statement text, which says the requirement does NOT apply to householder schemes. The requirement name is wrong and so is the application type.
issues.evidence: 'A demolition method statement Please note that this validation requirement does not apply to householder schemes'

issues.detail: Lawful development cert shows '(none)', yet the current list has a specific requirement for certificates of lawfulness for existing residential uses. Grokbot placed that evidence requirement under Full planning. Lighting Assessment is also placed under Listed building consent and Advertisement consent only because the old text mentions a listed building as a location. Most of the other 27 Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', even though the current list ties them to specific scales, uses and areas.
issues.evidence: 'Certificates of lawfulness for existing residential uses - sworn statement(s), Council Tax evidence ... accurate layout plans'

issues.detail: Several triggers are garbled or wrong. Design and Access Statement uses table-of-contents text ('PART 4 Minimum Requirements for Applications for Outline Planning Permission 36 PART 5 ...'). Pre-application advice reuses S106 Heads of Terms text. Retail/Town Centre reads 'other main town centre uses located within the town centre', but the source requires a sequential appraisal and impact assessment for Class E(a) retail OUTSIDE a defined centre. Highways reads only 'highway and visibility splays.', and Affordable Housing is cut off before its 15+ dwelling threshold.
issues.evidence: Source: 'Main town centre uses outside a defined centre - retail proposals (Class E(a)) ... sequential appraisal and impact assessment (Policies CS4 and DM15)'; affordable housing statement for 'residential schemes of 15 or more dwellings'

issues.detail: Viability Assessment is shown only as the planning-obligations viability text. 'Existing and proposed site levels / sections' and streetscene are recorded as requirements, but the current page lists levels plans, sections and photomontages under 'Recommendations (non-mandatory)', apart from the promenade and town-centre streetscene/CGI requirement.
issues.evidence: Current page: 'Recommendations' - levels plans, streetscene drawings, section drawings, photographs/photo-montages strongly recommended but not required for validation

issues.detail: The tab items are process text and fragments, not requirements: 'Under such circumstances it may be returned to you.'; 'If an application is submitted without the necessary information it will not be valid and may be returned to you. 1.'; 'Even if you submit the application forms electronically, you may still send us paper copies...'; 'The scale should be indicated on the plan and a north point provided.' (a national drawing standard); and the cut-off 'DESIGNATED SITES ... Local Sites (e.g.'.
issues.evidence: tab_items sections 'Submission rules' and 'Policy-driven requirements (all application types)'

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' field is the planning.data.gov.uk entity page, not the council's planning web page. Floor plans, elevations and roof plan rows under Listed building consent are national requirements quoting the repealed GDPO 1995, not local requirements.

summary: Grokbot's link is a superseded pre-2021 Word checklist from the democracy file store. Most of its requirements come from that file, while the current list (the Local validation checklist web page, last modified 17 Oct 2025) adds airport height, SUDS proforma, biodiversity matrix, BREEAM, broadband, parking review and several other items that Grokbot missed. Several items are also placed under the wrong application type (prior approval, householder).
